body.statement: For every rational \(0<\eta<3/20\), \(P^{\diamond}\in\mathcal M_{\eta,0}^{1\mathrm c}\), \(\psi^{\diamond},\psi^{\diamond,\mathrm{sw}}\in\Theta_{\eta,0}^{1\mathrm c}\), and \(F(\psi^{\diamond})=F(\psi^{\diamond,\mathrm{sw}})=P^{\diamond}\). The global and one-collision quotient fibers coincide and have exactly two classes. Their ATT vectors are \((9/250,-33/2500)\) and \((-1/500,49/5000)\), so \(\mathcal I_{0,3}^{1\mathrm c}(P^{\diamond})=\{-1/500,9/250\}\) and \(\mathcal I_{0,4}^{1\mathrm c}(P^{\diamond})=\{-33/2500,49/5000\}\). Moreover, \(\mathcal C_\eta^{\diamond}\) is a nonempty relatively open sign chamber in the named collision variety; every law in a relative neighborhood of \(P^{\diamond}\) within that chamber has two separated quotient ATT components with the same branch labels and coordinatewise ordering.
body.justification: A rational witness and a relatively open singular chamber show that disconnected geometry is structural rather than a numerical artifact at one isolated law.
body.gap: Generic label-switching observations do not establish a causal ATT gap after quotienting simultaneous labels, and the cited mixture papers provide no one-collision open chamber with exact values.
body.consumer: Regression tests for \(ak\) can verify exact branch retention and prevent software from replacing two attainable values by their interval hull.
